purpose: Synthetic proxy for Clothic's first-record to repeat-record journey and recovery states
requiredGates: all v1 habit journey assertions pass
wardrobe loading and fetch failures are recoverable
unavailable reminder delivery is not promised
typecheck, lint, format and avatar checks pass
limitations: This is a deterministic product-flow proxy, not observed D7 retention.
The app has no push or background reminder producer in the MVP.
Browser interaction and device accessibility remain separate manual gates when no session is available.
